attributes.description: Nginx connection handling and request processing from the OTel nginx receiver: current connections by state (active, reading, writing, waiting), connection accept/handle/drop rates, request throughput, and per-instance request rate and dropped connections.

embeddableConfig.content:
## Server Internals

Nginx connection handling and request processing from the `nginxreceiver.otel` stub_status metrics.

- **Key metrics** — average active, reading, writing and waiting connections, accepted connections/s and request rate
- **Connection handling** — connections by state, busy share, and accepted vs handled per second; a gap between them means dropped connections
- **Request throughput** — request rate and requests served per handled connection
- **Per instance** — top instances by request rate and dropped connections, and a per-instance summary table

attributes.description: Sum of current active nginx connections.

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE state == "active"
| STATS `Active connections` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current))

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE state == "active"
| STATS `Active connections` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| WHERE state == "active"
| STATS `Active connections` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current))

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS busy = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) WHERE state IN ("reading", "writing"),
    active = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) WHERE state == "active"
    BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Busy share` = busy / active * 100
| KEEP Time, `Busy share`

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS busy = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) WHERE state IN ("reading", "writing"),
    active = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(nginx.connections_current)) WHERE state == "active"
    BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Busy share` = busy / active * 100
| KEEP Time, `Busy share`

attributes.description: Requests served per second by each nginx instance (top 10 per time bucket). An instance diverging from its peers points to load-balancer or instance problems.

query.esql:
TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS `Request rate` = SUM(RATE(nginx.requests)) BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name
| SORT Time ASC, `Request rate` DESC, host.name ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY Time

TS metrics-nginxreceiver.otel-*
| STATS `Request rate` = SUM(RATE(nginx.requests)) BY Time = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name
| SORT Time ASC, `Request rate` DESC, host.name ASC
| LIMIT 10 BY Time

query.esql:
